boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.target: 通用 增加自然抗性穿透

entries.source:
Your skill at Chanting now extends the cloak of light, increasing your light radius by %d.
		Also, when you start a new Chant, you will be cured of all cross-tier effects and cured of up to %d debuffs.
		Chant of Fortitude cures mental effects.
		Chant of Fortress cures physical effects.
		Chant of Resistance cures magical effects.
entries.target:
咏唱赞歌的娴熟技艺让光明得以扩散，增加 %d 光照半径。
		每次你咏唱新的赞歌时，你将解除自身的越层效果（失去平衡、法术冲击和思维封锁），并额外解除 %d 项相应类型的负面状态。
		坚韧赞歌：解除精神负面状态
		堡垒赞歌：解除物理负面状态
		元素赞歌：解除魔法负面状态。

entries.source: %s is knocked back by the gale!
Clones all creatures in a radius of 10.
entries.target: 复制半径十格范围内所有生物。

entries.source: Indeed, it is both promising and ominous. I can reward you handsomely for your efforts, but they will lead you into deadly peril to which, I assume, the previous three fellows who went off on my errand never to return can attest.
entries.target: 确实，既大有希望，又透着不祥。我会为你的效劳提供丰厚的回报，但这也将引你踏入致命险境——我想，前三个替我办事后便一去不回的家伙足以证明这一点。
新职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#太阳骑士（天空系）

entries.source: I want to change your equipment.
Blood drips continuously from this fell suit of iron, and dark magics churn almost visibly around it. Bloody ruin comes to those who stand against its wearer.
entries.target: 鲜血不断的从这套骇人的铁甲上滴落，几乎可以看得见黑魔法在它的周围流动。胆敢阻挡装备者的人会遭到血腥的毁灭。

entries.source: #VIOLET#You have learned the talent Relentless Pursuit.
Start to sever the lifeline of the target. After 4 turns, if the target is still in line of sight of you, its existance will be ended (%d temporal damage).
entries.target: 引导法术离断目标的生命线，如果 4 回合之后目标仍然在视线内则会立即死亡(%d 时空伤害)。

entries.source: Got to level 50 of the infinite dungeon.
Ghouls are dumb, but resilient, rotting undead creatures, making good fighters.
entries.target: 食尸鬼是愚钝但坚韧的腐烂不死生物，适合成为战士。

entries.source: release a radius %d burst of void energy at up to range %d, dealing %0.2f temporal and %0.2f darkness damage (based on Magic)
entries.target: 在 %d 码范围内释放虚空能量，至多距离 %d。造成 %0.2f 时空和 %0.2f 暗影伤害。（基于魔法）

entries.source:
You feel your grip on reality slipping.
#CRIMSON#Penalty : #WHITE#Fractured Sanity: %+d%% Mind Resistance, %+d%% Confusion Immunity
#CRIMSON#Power 1+: %sUnleashed: %+d%% critical damage, %+d%% off-hand weapon damage
#CRIMSON#Power 2+: %s%+d Luck, %+d Dexterity
#CRIMSON#Power 3+: %sConspirator: Your madness is contagious. Every time you critically damage a foe there is a %d%% chance to spread one of your current detrimental mental effect to them.
#CRIMSON#Power 4+: %sMania: Once per turn, when an attack does more than %0.1f%% of your life, the remaining cooldown of all your talents is reduced by 1.
entries.target:
你觉得你对现实失去控制。
#CRIMSON# 惩罚：#WHITE# 扰乱心智：%+d%% 精神抗性 , %+d%% 混乱免疫
#CRIMSON# 强度 1+：%s 解除束缚：%+d%% 暴击伤害，%+d%% 副手武器伤害。
#CRIMSON# 强度 2+：%s%+d 幸运，%+d 敏捷
#CRIMSON# 强度 3+：%s 阴谋：你的疯狂是会传染的。每次你对敌人造成暴击伤害时，都有 %d%% 的几率将你当前的负面精神效果传播给他们。
#CRIMSON# 强度 4+：%s 狂热：每回合一次，当一次攻击超过你生命的 %0.1f%% 时，你所有技能的剩余冷却时间减少 1。

entries.source: #00FF00#The elixir seems to have subtly repositioned your entire being within the fabric of reality!
entries.target: #00FF00#这瓶炼金药剂似乎将你的整个存在在现实结构中微妙地重新定位了！

entries.source: Nothing for now. Sorry to have taken your time. Farewell, my lady.
entries.target: 暂时无事。抱歉耽误了您的时间。告辞，女士。
通往诺尔格斯巢穴的路

entries.source:
You move through the dream world, reappearing at a nearby location.
		If there is a sleeping creature at the target location, you'll appear as close to them as possible, otherwise, you'll appear within %d tiles of your intended destination.
entries.target:
你穿越梦境，出现在某个目标地点附近。
		如果目标为处于睡眠状态的生物，你将会出现在离目标最近的地方。
		否则，你会出现在目标位置的 %d 码范围内。

entries.source: #F53CBE#You feel your rampage slowing down. (-1 duration)
entries.target: #F53CBE#你感受到你的暴走开始减速。（-1持续时间）

entries.source: %s go to the southeast, and tell Aeryn what happened to me!
entries.target: %s，去东南方，告诉艾琳我的遭遇！

entries.source:
Launches a knife with intense power doing %0.2f physical damage to all targets in line.
		The damage will increase with Mindpower
entries.target:
对一条直线目标发射一把锋利的刀刃造成 %0.2f 物理伤害。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

entries.source:
Increases all unarmed damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 (including grapples and kicks).
		Note that brawlers naturally gain 0.5 Physical Power per character level while unarmed (current brawler physical power bonus: %0.1f) and attack 20%% faster while unarmed.
entries.target:
增加 %d%% 所有徒手伤害，提高 30 物理强度（包括抓取/徒手技）。
		注意：徒手战斗时，格斗家具有随等级每级增加 0.5 物理强度。（当前提高 %0.1f 物理强度）和攻击速度提高 20%% 的固有属性。

entries.source: Increases your maximum energy by %d. You also gain %0.1f Psi for each kill and %0.1f Psi for each mind critical.
entries.target: 增加灵能值上限 %d。每次杀死敌人获得 %0.1f 灵能值，每次精神暴击获得 %0.1f 灵能值。

entries.source: This ugly orc looks really nasty and vicious. He wields a huge two-handed sword and means to use it.
entries.target: 这名丑陋的兽人看起来阴险狡诈。他手持双手大剑并擅长此道。

entries.source: A clean-looking Human resident of Last Hope.
entries.target: 一位面容清秀的最后希望市民。

entries.source:
This is the name of your character.
Right mouse click to generate a random name based on race and sex.
entries.target:
这是你的角色名。
右键该选框会随机起名，名字组合取决于你的种族和性别。

entries.source: This lightweight armor appears to have been woven of countless sprouts, still curling and growing. When you put it on, you feel the weight of the world on your shoulders, in spite of how light it feels in your hands.
entries.target: 这件护甲由数以千计的豆芽缠绕编成，豆芽们仍在不停的生长缠绕。尽管在你手里很轻，但当穿上它时，你感觉到肩上那世界一般的重量。

entries.source: , who incubated her eggs in the corpse,
entries.target: ，她在这具尸体中孵化了她的卵，
